ayahs.en: The power of Abu Lahab will perish, and he will perish.

ayahs.ar: مَآ أَغْنَىٰ عَنْهُ مَالُهُۥ وَمَا كَسَبَ
ayahs.en: His wealth and gains will not exempt him.
He will be plunged in flaming Fire,
Will have upon her neck a halter of palm-fibre.
